description: This source file contains unit tests for Orleans gateway selection and load balancing mechanisms. It tests the logic for distributing client connections across gateways using round-robin strategy, verifying even load distribution across multiple gateways. It also includes a test implementation of the IGatewayListProvider interface for controlled testing.

classes.name: GatewaySelectionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying gateway selection and load balancing in Orleans. Includes tests for round-robin distribution and a mock gateway list provider.

methods.name: GatewaySelection
methods.description: Test that verifies the gateway manager distributes connections evenly using round-robin.

methods.name: Test_GatewaySelection
methods.description: Core logic that simulates multiple gateway selections and asserts even distribution of selections across gateways.
